title: Explicit bounded partial DWG-read policy
mode: Generated fast implementation slice with local diagnostic negative controls
scope: Separate DWG semantic-read completeness policy from owner/reference closure while preserving strict CLI defaults.
Allow partial output only with successful source-matched reads, finalized and exactly accounted terminal frame dispositions, and a complete non-saturated integrity ledger without retained errors.
Exercise generated partial-read behavior and CLI token/overwrite contracts without adding persistent DWG/DXF fixtures.

changes.detail: Added Legacy, RequireComplete, and AllowPartial read-completeness policies.
Added a trailing defaulted policy argument to fileExport; Legacy preserves prior source behavior.

Added bounded partial-read admission independent of strict owner checks; partial mode requires a successful receipt, final frame ledger, complete integrity evidence, and no retained integrity errors. Unknown policy enum values fail closed.
Kept CLI conversion strict by default, wired explicit partial opt-in through positional, FreeCAD, and batch routes, and emitted a non-promoting warning for DWG input.
Documented strict default, partial admission boundaries, unchanged owner/reference checks, and non-support-claim semantics.

Extended the generated read-outcome selector to prove strict refusal, explicit partial LINE preservation after a malformed HATCH, rejection of unfinished frame ledgers and unknown policy values, and unchanged owner-closure refusal with sentinel preservation.
Added exact-token, positional/-o acceptance, invalid-suffix, overwrite-authority controls, and an options-only fast selector.
Recorded the implementation result, local AC1018/AC1024 negative controls, focused validation, and self-unblocking continuation.

existingSubplansAdvanced: PAR-06/PAR-07/S8 now has a distinct explicit partial-read policy while preserving strict CLI completeness and owner/reference gates
assessment.planImpact: Strict conversion remains the default. No file-format, peer, native-consumer, or 3D support claim is promoted.
